title: Gate 3 closes on machine evidence: release.decide auto-approves a gap-free criterion-bound dossier under a recorded opt-in
description:
SPIDR child C of parent task-d56a0cc5f6ae4dc88da5233a9702d9e6 ("One approval, then unattended"), split 2026-09-09 by architect-fa84777a. Sibling of child A (task-a47301ee3aa64866ba109d4c0283526f, the mapping + carried opt-ins leaf) and child B (Gate 2 / preview.decide). This row is Gate 3 ONLY.

DEPENDS ON TWO ROWS, both declared in dependsOn and both currently unlanded:
- task-a47301ee3aa64866ba109d4c0283526f supplies the AdvisoryRiskClass -> PolicyRiskTier mapping and makes the live dispatch carry auto-approval opt-ins instead of `autoApprovalOptIns: []`. Without it there is no opt-in for this gate to act under.
- task-b8ec9a638f6540c28798c29f23fd5ada ("Release evidence is bound to criterion receipts at the released SHA") supplies the criterion-bound dossier. MEASURED 2026-09-09: that row is status PLANNING with commits 0 - the criterion-bound dossier DOES NOT EXIST at HEAD yet. Auto-releasing on today's dossier would auto-release on evidence weaker than goal closure demands, which is exactly the defect the 2026-09-09 external review found. Do NOT plan against a dossier shape until that row lands; read its verification and completionSummary from get_context.epicSiblings rather than re-measuring HEAD.

OWNER DIRECTION driving the parent (2026-09-09): "we dont want moe-next to be stuck all the time for user approval we can approve the plan at the start but thats it". One human gate at plan/contract time; the rest unattended, with a human ABLE to intervene but not REQUIRED.

MEASURED AT HEAD 2026-09-09 by architect-fa84777a; re-measure before planning:
- `git grep -ln "evaluatePolicy|PolicyRiskTier|autoApprovalOptIns" -- apps/daemon/src/release/**` returns NOTHING. The release gate does not consult the policy engine at all today. This row BUILDS that consumption path; it is not flipping on a dark switch. The parent's description called the engine "dark", which is true of the two seams it names but understates this: there is no policy call at either gate.
- The decision function this row must call, and must NOT reimplement, is packages/core/src/policy/policy-evaluation.ts assessTier at :150-166. R2/R3 return REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL with code HUMAN_ONLY_TIER (:155-158). A tier with no matching opt-in returns REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL with code AUTO_APPROVAL_NOT_OPTED_IN (:165). An opt-in matches only when `entry.action === action && tierRank(entry.tier) >= tierRank(tier)`.
- policy-composition.ts foldSlices at :132-170 returns `optIns: last.autoApprovalOptIns` - the LAST slice in the chain wins. An opt-in that is not in the final slice is not in effect.
- apps/daemon/src/release/ holds release-decide-contracts.ts, release-decide-command.ts, release-decide-service.ts, release-decide-wiring.test.ts, release-dossier-contracts.ts, release-dossier-ledger.ts and their tests. RELEASE_DECIDE_COMMAND_KIND is defined in release-decide-contracts.ts and consumed at daemon-command-async-entries.ts:11,59,193,353-356.
- release.decide is in OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_KINDS (daemon-command-vocabulary.ts:405) and MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS is DERIVED from that set, so a roster edit opens TWO fences in one line. Landed rows task-54b74b8041c64 and task-20b7d6bba60f4 established that fence deliberately.

WHO SUBMITS THE AUTOMATIC DECISION. Do NOT widen the MCP allowlist and do NOT let an agent seat decide a gate. The automatic decision is taken SERVER-SIDE inside the daemon under the operator principal acting on a recorded opt-in, never as a wire command from a seat. Governor ruling of 2026-09-06 (quoted on task-136cbab2, comment-b0d0a809c1a7445e91f03f83ea69329d) is binding: do NOT remove a kind from OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_KINDS; if you find yourself editing a roster you have left the approved scope, stop and report. The precedent for a typed narrow arm is the SOFT_POLICY_WAIVER handling in the registry.

A MANUAL REJECT WINS. If a human has already recorded a REJECT for the release, the automatic path must not overturn it, and the refusal must carry a stable code asserted WITH its layer. Prefer an EXISTING code from the release refusal vocabulary over minting a new one; POLICY_REASON_CODES in packages/core is a closed frozen list and this row does not own it.

OUT OF SCOPE, owned by siblings: the risk-class mapping and the carried opt-ins (row A); anything under apps/daemon/src/preview/ (row B); the end-to-end unattended journey arm (the parent). Do not widen POLICY_AUTO_APPROVAL_TIERS.
definitionOfDone: release.decide consults the policy engine: a production module under apps/daemon/src/release/ calls evaluatePolicy from the @moe/core bare specifier and does NOT reimplement tier or opt-in logic; `git grep -n 'evaluatePolicy' -- apps/daemon/src/release/` returns at least one non-test hit, quoted in the completion record.

An arm proves the AUTOMATIC APPROVE path: a gap-free criterion-bound dossier at the released SHA, under a recorded R0 or R1 opt-in whose action equals RELEASE_DECIDE_COMMAND_KIND, is released with NO human decision, and the persisted decision record NAMES the opt-in it acted under (action and tier), so a reviewer can tell an automatic approval from a human one. Assert the recorded provenance fields, not merely that the outcome was ACCEPTED.

An arm proves a dossier carrying a CRITERION GAP is NOT auto-released even under a valid R0 opt-in, asserting the specific stable gap code AND the layer that refused. The gap code must be read from the prerequisite row's landed dossier vocabulary (task-b8ec9a638f6540c28798c29f23fd5ada), never invented here.

An arm proves R2 and R3 are not auto-released: the gate stays pending for a human and the refusal carries HUMAN_ONLY_TIER from evaluatePolicy, asserted with its layer. A separate arm asserts POLICY_AUTO_APPROVAL_TIERS still deep-equals ['R0','R1'] and that this row modified no file under packages/core/src/policy/.

An arm proves a recorded human REJECT WINS: with a manual REJECT already recorded and a valid R0 opt-in present, the automatic path does not overturn it and refuses with a stable code asserted together with its layer. Verify non-vacuity by mutating the precedence check in the production module and confirming this arm goes RED, with the drill's restore proven by SHA256 equality against an out-of-tree backup whose path carries this task id.

The human-only fence is UNCHANGED: RELEASE_DECIDE_COMMAND_KIND is still in OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_KINDS and still in MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS, and no agent seat or MCP tool can submit a gate decision. Assert BOTH directions per global rail 9 - enumerate the served set from the dispatch seam, not only from the roster constant - and leave the existing wiring and authorization tests green.

pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test EXITS 0 with its `Test Files N passed` count line quoted and NONZERO, and pnpm typecheck exits 0. If any command kind or payload shape changed, all four GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST mirrors are re-censused with a full-tree `git grep` of the literal across ALL file types and pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test is also run and quoted; if nothing changed, state that explicitly with the census command output.

implementationPlan.description: MEASURE, NO WRITES — and this step decides two things the plan deliberately leaves to the delivered tree. (1) THE GAP CODE (DoD 3): read get_context.epicSiblings for task-b8ec9a638f6540c28798c29f23fd5ada; require status DONE (this row's dependsOn gates you until it is); read its completionSummary, verification and row comments for the DossierGapCode member it added for 'no PASSED criterion receipt at the released sha' (planned spelling CRITERION_NOT_VERIFIED_AT_SHA — the worker may have deviated). Confirm on disk at the delivered tree: `git show <its completion sha> -- apps/daemon/src/release/release-dossier-sections.ts` and `grep -n '^  | "' apps/daemon/src/release/release-dossier-sections.ts`. Bind every arm to the LANDED spelling and cite the sha in a comment beside the constant. If the sibling folded the case into an existing code, assert whichever code its own arm asserts and record the deviation in a row comment. If you somehow hold this row with the sibling not DONE: moe.report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds, never invent a code. (2) THE PROVENANCE KEY AND LAYER LITERAL: read epicSiblings for Gate 2, task-b8571cfe50614c1d89fee3a0a448de10. If DONE, use its landed provenance key name and the layer literal it used for policy-answered yields. If not DONE, use `provenance` (value `{action, tier} | null`) and the literal `"CORE_REDUCER"` (the daemon's existing literal for core-answered refusals, bootstrap-policy-services.ts:196), and post a comment on Gate 2 naming both so it aligns. (3) RAIL 7 EDGE, all three halves, quoted: apps/daemon/package.json declares `@moe/core` (measured `workspace:*`); pnpm-lock.yaml importer `apps/daemon` links `../../packages/core`; a throwaway `.ts` under apps/daemon/src importing `evaluatePolicy, POLICY_AUTO_APPROVAL_TIERS` from the bare `@moe/core` typechecks exit 0 and is deleted in the same command. (4) Re-anchor: HEAD at plan time ecf0b862; design anchors were read at b3d295d8 with zero source drift since. Record wc -l: release-decide-service.ts 227, release-receipt-contracts.ts 165, release-receipt-ledger.ts 155, daemon-store-foundation-composition.ts 857 (ALREADY over the 400 hard cap — pre-existing; this row adds at most five lines there). Baseline: `src/release/release-receipt-ledger.test.ts` = `Tests 8 passed (8)`; `src/release/release-decide-wiring.test.ts` = `6 passed`.

THE LEAF: apps/daemon/src/release/release-auto-approval.ts (NEW, target <=250) plus its tracked one-line `.js` bridge, as every module in release/ has. Two responsibilities, one module. (A) `evaluateReleaseAutoApproval(store, {projectId, goalId, sha, operatorPrincipalId})` calls `evaluatePolicy` from the `@moe/core` BARE specifier — DoD 1 forbids reimplementing tier or opt-in logic. Inputs the daemon convention already uses (approval-record-facts.ts:215-231): tier from `readCriterionGoal(store, projectId, goalId).graph.planningRunRef` -> `readRunPolicyEvaluation(store, {projectId, runId}).evaluation.riskTier` (replay-verified, daemon-computed); ONE fact `{factId: \`release.run_policy_tier:${runId}\`, tier: riskTier, truthClass: "DAEMON_VERIFIED"}`; `action: RELEASE_DECIDE_COMMAND_KIND`; `actor: operatorPrincipalId`; `decisionDigest: "0".repeat(64)` (run-policy-evaluation.ts:168 precedent); `evaluatorVersion: POLICY_EVALUATOR_VERSION`; `scope: [goalId]`; `sliceChain: [<the LAST digest-addressed installed evaluation slice>]` chosen exactly as run-policy-selection-snapshot.ts:92-99 does; `waivers: []`. Absent run-policy row or slice -> yield, fail closed. The opt-in is NAMED for provenance by `slice.autoApprovalOptIns.find(e => e.action === RELEASE_DECIDE_COMMAND_KIND)` — a lookup for naming, never a second decision; ALLOW with no nameable opt-in -> yield (Gate 2's rule). (B) The auto-approval RECORD codec + ledger: store-only commandKind `internal.release.auto_approval` under principal `daemon:release-auto-approval` (precedent `internal.release.receipt` / `daemon:release`, release-receipt-contracts.ts:24-26) on its OWN aggregate `release-auto:<goalId>` so evaluating never bumps `release:<goalId>` and never invalidates a human's offered expectedVersion; keyed by the deterministic commandId from step 4; exact keys `{version: "moe-release-auto-approval/1", commandId, goalId, sha, optIn: {action, tier}, sliceRef, subjectTier, reasonCodes}`; `readReleaseAutoApproval(store, projectId, commandId)`. NOT a runtime kind — an arm asserts it is absent from RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS so no digest mirror rotates. NEVER declare a `*_LAYER`/`*_LAYERS` constant in either new module: the security scanners register it and demand a roster backfill. RED ARMS FIRST (in the step-7 test file): R0 subject + opt-in `{action: "release.decide", tier: "R1"}` -> ALLOW naming that opt-in; R2 and R3 subjects -> yield carrying HUMAN_ONLY_TIER; a slice whose only opt-in is for "preview.decide" -> AUTO_APPROVAL_NOT_OPTED_IN (exact action match, policy-evaluation.ts:157); two installed evaluation slices with the NEWEST lacking the opt-in -> not opted in (foldSlices takes the LAST slice's optIns, policy-composition.ts:161-166).

PROVENANCE ON THE RELEASE RECEIPT (DoD 2), three files. release-receipt-contracts.ts (165): bump RELEASE_RECEIPT_VERSION to `moe-release-receipt/2`, add the provenance key from step 1(2) to RECEIPT_KEYS (:46-49), and make the decoder (:127-165) admit BOTH vintages: version /1 with exactly the 9 old keys -> provenance null; /2 with exactly 10 keys, provenance null or `{action: non-empty string, tier in POLICY_AUTO_APPROVAL_TIERS}`; 11 keys or a tier outside the roster -> refused. THE HAZARD UNIQUE TO THIS ROW: `releaseReceiptId` (:106-108) HASHES RELEASE_RECEIPT_VERSION into the id. A naive bump rotates every receipt id: deploy-command.ts:297 and goal-deployment-read.ts:46 recompute the new id and lose every stored /1 RELEASED receipt, and decode's `receiptId !== releaseReceiptId(...)` check at :148 turns stored /1 receipts RELEASE_RECEIPT_INVALID, which release-evidence-read.ts:180-186 escalates to UNREADABLE for the whole release read. Pin `RECEIPT_ID_DOMAIN = "moe-release-receipt/1"` as a separate literal used ONLY in the id hash; an arm asserts a /2 receipt's id equals sha256 over the literal-domain tuple and that a /1 receipt written before the bump still resolves by id. release-receipt-ledger.ts (155): `RecordReleaseReceiptInput` (:47-56) gains `provenance`; the write path passes it through; readers unchanged. release-decide-service.ts (227 -> ~240, near the 250 target; if over, move the join into the ledger by passing commandId): `record()` (:127-142) joins `readReleaseAutoApproval(store, projectId, envelope.commandId)` and sets `provenance = rec !== null && rec.goalId === goalId && rec.sha === sha ? rec.optIn : null`. A human dispatch (random UUID commandId, composition :424) finds no record -> null. The wrapper's 3-key terminal, DurableDecision, and the payload roster `["base","decision","goalId","sha"]` (payload-keys.ts:177) are UNTOUCHED — the wire contract does not move. release-evidence-read.ts's projection (:67-75) withholds fields by design; leave it (a card-visible provenance is a follow-up comment, not this row). RED ARMS (step-7 file): /1 bytes decode with provenance null; /2 with provenance decodes with the VALUES; /2 with 11 keys refused; /2 with tier "R2" refused; id stability across the bump; service: human dispatch -> null, auto record present -> `{action, tier}` values.

THE RECONCILER: apps/daemon/src/release/release-auto-decide.ts (NEW, target <=250) plus its `.js` bridge. WHY NOT GATE 2's SHAPE: Gate 2 fires from preview.start's async completion. Gate 3 has NO in-daemon completion moment — criterion receipts (criterion-runner.ts:104-111) and PUSHED publish receipts (publish-ledger.ts:180) are written by the WRAPPER's delivery.advance() (agent-wrapper-main.ts:316,:350), the dossier is recorded lazily INSIDE a release.decide dispatch (release-production-wiring.ts:62-71), and no store reactor exists. So: `registerReleaseAutoDecide(schedules, deps)` registers job id `"release/auto-decide"` on the EXISTING DurableSchedule (durable-schedule.ts:88 register; single-flight per job built in at :66; interval DEFAULT_SCHEDULE_INTERVAL_MS 60_000). Per tick: `readPublishLedger(store, projectId)` -> per goal `readRunGoalPublication(...)` (run-goal-publication.ts:7-22) -> candidates with `outcome === "PUSHED"` and non-null sha. PER CANDIDATE, IN THIS ORDER, BEFORE ANY JOURNAL WRITE — order is load-bearing, see attack A10: (0) `commandId = sha256hex(JSON.stringify(["release-auto", projectId, goalId, sha]))`; `store.getCommandDecision({commandId, principalId: operatorPrincipalId, projectId}) !== null` -> SKIP ALREADY_ATTEMPTED (ONE automatic attempt per (goal, sha); a REFUSED auto terminal parks the sha for a human — a documented bound, because a retried deterministic id hits RELEASE_COMMAND_BYTES_CONFLICT once the version moved). (1) `readReleaseReceipt(store, projectId, releaseReceiptId(projectId, goalId, sha, "RELEASED", null)).ok` -> yield `RELEASE_COMMAND_ID_REQUIRED @ DAEMON_COMMAND_SEAM` (the service's own pair, :186). (2) HUMAN REJECT WINS (DoD 5): walk `store.readEvents(releaseDossierAggregateId(goalId))`; any `ReleaseCommandDecided` whose payload decodes to `{outcome: "DECIDED", resultCode: "REJECTED", effectId: null}` (release-decide-command.ts:213-217) -> yield `RELEASE_COMMAND_ID_REQUIRED @ DAEMON_COMMAND_SEAM` with detail naming `event.decisionTrace.principalId`. Scope is PER GOAL: any recorded REJECT parks the goal's automatic path until a human decides; a new sha does not un-park it. The auto path never REJECTs, so REJECTED == human by construction; the service is NOT made sticky for a later human APPROVE. (3) an Admitted without a Decided on the same walk (hasPendingRelease, :113-125) -> SKIP. (4) `dossierFacts(goalId, sha)` null -> SKIP; `releaseDossierGaps(facts.input, sha, facts.ancestry)` non-empty -> yield `RELEASE_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE @ DAEMON_PREREQUISITE` carrying `gaps[].code` (DoD 3 asserts the CODE from this yield — the service's own detail names only criterion ids). NO dispatch on gaps. (5) step-2 policy not ALLOW -> yield `{code: reasonCodes, layer: <step 1(2) literal>}`. (6) write the auto-approval record. (7) `expectedVersion = store.getAggregateVersion(releaseDossierAggregateId(goalId))` — read AFTER the walk. (8) dispatch through `registry.get(RELEASE_DECIDE_COMMAND_KIND)?.asyncHandler` on the ALREADY-COMPOSED registry (never a second createAsyncCommandEntries — that mints a second PR port; async-entries.ts:174-181 forbids a second push path), with a synthesized envelope that survives decodeRuntimeCommandEnvelopeBytes (release-decide-command.ts:94): exact keys `commandId, commandKind: "release.decide", correlationId, expectedVersion, payload: {base, decision: "APPROVE", goalId, sha}, requestDigest` (sha256 of the payload bytes; the wrapper recomputes identity from the server-known principal, :169-175), `schemaVersion: RUNTIME_COMMAND_ENVELOPE_VERSION, sessionCredential: "daemon:release-auto-decide"` (never authenticated on this path; document that this is the boot-reconciliation precedent, not a hole), `targetAggregateId: releaseDossierAggregateId(goalId)`. Principal = `{capabilities: OPERATOR_CAPABILITIES, principalId: config.principalId, projectId}` — the SAME id boot reconciliation acts under (composition :635); it passes assertReleasePrincipal with NO roster edit. A DomainRefusal from dispatch (EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT / RELEASE_COMMAND_IN_PROGRESS 409 = a human got there first) is a per-goal OUTCOME, never a throw — durable-schedule.ts:70 flattens any throw to SCHEDULE_CALLBACK_FAILED and discards the reason. `base`: there is NO server fact for the base branch (grep defaultBranch|baseBranch|targetBranch non-test = 0; ProjectRemote is `{boundAt, boundBy, remoteUrl}`); take it from deps, injected by step 5; ABSENT -> the reconciler yields for every candidate (fail closed; the human decides with their own base). Do NOT add a fourth key to RELEASE_DECIDE_CODE_LAYER_MAP ("exactly three keys, closed", :38-45; sibling b8ec9a63's DoD pins it). RED ARMS (step-7 file): REJECT wins with code AND layer; RELEASED skip; gap yield with the landed code AND DAEMON_PREREQUISITE; ALREADY_ATTEMPTED skip; two concurrent ticks against a blocking publisher -> exactly ONE ReleaseCommandAdmitted; a version bump between (7) and (8) -> outcome EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT and the

COMPOSITION, at most five lines in apps/daemon/src/daemon-store-foundation-composition.ts (857 lines — ALREADY over the 400 hard cap, pre-existing; this row does not fix that and adds nothing else there). Beside the HEALTH_PROBE_JOB_ID registration at :801: read `MOE_RELEASE_BASE` once from the process environment (the DEPLOY_BUILD_CONTEXT_ENV_KEY shape at async-entries.ts:249-250 — host-scoped daemon config, passed RAW; a hard-coded "main" contradicts the codebase's posture at :270-274), and call `registerReleaseAutoDecide(schedules, {store, projectId, principalId: config.principalId, registry, base, dossierFacts, clock})`; throw on a registration refusal exactly as the health job does. Optionally add `"release/auto-decide"` to the resolver ternary at :788-789 so the constructor's rebuild does not emit a transient SCHEDULE_TARGET_UNRESOLVED before register re-arms it (:53,:131-143) — one line. Do NOT wire this in daemon-command-async-entries.ts (385 lines, near the cap, and the wrong seam). ARMS (step-7 file): the composed schedules carry `"release/auto-decide"` with no refusal; the reconciler's principal equals `config.principalId`; and — attack A7 — dispatching under a `daemon:*` principalId is REFUSED OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_REQUIRED 403 by the fence (release-decide-command.ts:69-73), proving the fence still binds the daemon's own call and that only the composed operator id passes.

THE JOURNEY ARMS — DoD 2 positive and DoD 5 precedence, end to end, in the new test file. Use `journeyWorld("SUBMITTED")` from gates-journey-fixtures.ts:331-380, which already reaches RELEASED, plus an installed opt-in-bearing evaluation slice: the fixture pattern at policy-allowance-fixtures.ts:32-43 derives a digest-addressed slice with `[{action, tier: "R0"}]`. THE FIXTURE TRAP: bootstrap-test-fixtures.ts's POLICY_SLICE is opt-in-less and the demo seed carries `autoApprovalOptIns: []` (demo-seed-policy.ts:60-61); foldSlices takes the LAST slice, so the opt-in slice MUST be installed LAST, and an arm proves installing the seed AFTER it silently disables auto-release (attack A4 — document that the opt-in must be the newest installed evaluation slice). POSITIVE (DoD 2): one tick -> a RELEASED receipt whose provenance carries the opt-in's action and tier VALUES, and ZERO human commands in the journal — only the deterministic commandId appears (an arm asserting only RELEASED is vacuous against a human decision; assert the provenance values and the absence of any other release.decide decision). Vocabulary note: the preview receipt outcome is `"REFUSED" | "STARTED"`, not DEPLOYED; the journey reads STARTED. PRECEDENCE (DoD 5): record a human REJECT through the real handler first, then tick -> the automatic path yields `RELEASE_COMMAND_ID_REQUIRED @ DAEMON_COMMAND_SEAM`, no auto-approval record is written, `release:<goalId>`'s version is unchanged. HUMAN-ONLY TIERS (DoD 4): R2 and R3 subjects -> yield carrying HUMAN_ONLY_TIER with the step 1(2) layer literal; `POLICY_AUTO_APPROVAL_TIERS` deep-equals `["R0", "R1"]`; `git diff --name-only <merge-base>..HEAD -- packages/core/src/policy/` is EMPTY.

THE FENCE, BOTH DIRECTIONS (DoD 6), THE CENSUS (DoD 7), AND THE GATES. Fence arm in the new test file, enumerated from the SEAM per global rail 9: `S = [...registry.keys()].filter(k => OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_KINDS.has(k))`; assert `wiredMcpToolKinds()` (mcp-tool-allowlist.ts:99) is DISJOINT from S; assert every registry kind absent from `wiredMcpToolKinds()` is either in S or has `agentCapabilitiesFor(kind) === null` — set-equality of the partition, not subset; assert `"release.decide"` is in S. Leave gates-human-only-fence.test.ts:153-178 and mcp-tool-allowlist.test.ts:157-160/:246-256 (:250 pins the excluded length 27) GREEN and UNTOUCHED. CENSUS: this row adds NO runtime command kind, so no GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST mirror rotates — prove it by HEX, not by symbol (a symbol grep misses three mirrors): `git grep -n f1878eeaa08a050c12000a0e9885a4fef11c12c824602c1b50696d970f2dd295 -- . ':!.serena' ':!.moe' ':!.codex' ':!.grok'` must return the same six files as at plan time (data-adapter.test.ts, approve-plan-reject.test.tsx, approve-plan.test.tsx, plan-run-resolution.test.tsx, generated-coverage.test.ts, generated-client.ts); an arm asserts `"internal.release.auto_approval"` is NOT in RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS; `git grep -n "release.decide" -- apps/daemon/src/daemon-command-vocabulary.ts apps/daemon/src/mcp-tool-allowlist.ts` unchanged vs the merge-base. GATES, foreground, standalone, no pipes: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon exec vitest run --config package.json --maxWorkers=1 --testTimeout=30000 src/release/release-auto-decide.test.ts` -> `Test Files 1 passed (1)` and `Tests N passed (N)` with N >= 15 (the arms named in steps 2-7); then `src/release/release-receipt-ledger.test.ts` still 8; then `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck` EXIT 0; then under `full-suite-gate` (acquire_resource; GATE START): `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` with its count line quoted and NONZERO, `pnpm typecheck` EXIT 0, and `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test` quoted (cheap, and the census sits beside it); GATE END. Read the COUNT LINES, not exit codes. Path-attributed baseline for any foreign red.

ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW against the design's attack list, the DoD 5 DRILL, then complete. Attacks to answer in the record: A1 two ticks race (single-flight in-process; across two daemons the deterministic id makes the loser hit RELEASE_COMMAND_IN_PROGRESS or EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT; admission is an atomic two-leg commit); A2 a stale version must be an outcome, never a throw the schedule flattens; A5 gap-free at evaluation but a gap before the PR — the service re-folds at dispatch and refuses; the orphaned auto record is acceptable; the REFUSED auto terminal parks the sha (state the bound in the module header); A6 a human REJECT between evaluation and commit bumps the aggregate by two, so the auto dispatch's pre-REJECT version is refused at :189/:190; A10 journal churn — confirm the three-tick unchanged-version arm; A12 a hostile `MOE_RELEASE_BASE`; A15 the sessionCredential placeholder is never authority (the wrapper recomputes identity from the server-known principal). DoD 5 DRILL on the REJECT branch (2) of release-auto-decide.ts — an UNTRACKED file, so `git diff` is blind: (i) `git status --porcelain apps/daemon/src/release/release-auto-decide.ts` (expect `??`); (ii) copy out of tree to `%TEMP%/moe-task-24b68b05-release-auto-decide-<workerId>.ts` — the task id in the path is mandatory; (iii) in a SEPARATE call, SHA256 of the live file equals the backup's AND the backup contains no mutant token (proves vintage); (iv) mutate: make the REJECT walk return false; (v) run the single file — ONLY the REJECT-wins arm goes RED (expected `RELEASE_COMMAND_ID_REQUIRED @ DAEMON_COMMAND_SEAM`, got a RELEASED receipt with provenance); if it stays GREEN a second layer answered first, typically expectedVersion because the fixture recorded the REJECT after the reconciler read the version — fix the fixture, not the assertion; (vi) restore by copying the backup back; (vii) SEPARATE call: live SHA256 equals the pre-drill hash; (viii) rerun GREEN. Never `git checkout --` or `git restore` on the shared tree; no full-suite lease held during the drill. Quote both hashes, the RED line and the GREEN count line in a row COMMENT before completionSummary (2000-char truncation). Report all nine touched paths in complete_step.modifiedFiles.

comments.content:
ARCHITECT DECISION RECORD — architect-ed42e60a, 2026-09-10, at plan time. Five decisions a worker must not re-derive; the plan's steps carry the mechanics.

1. TRIGGER: A SCHEDULED RECONCILER, NOT GATE 2's COMPLETION HOOK. Gate 2 (task-b8571cfe, now WORKING with an 8-step plan) fires from preview.start's async completion. Gate 3 cannot: criterion receipts (criterion-runner.ts:104-111) and PUSHED publish receipts (publish-ledger.ts:180) are written by the WRAPPER's delivery.advance() (agent-wrapper-main.ts:316,:350), not by any daemon handler; the dossier is recorded lazily INSIDE a release.decide dispatch (release-production-wiring.ts:62-71); no store reactor exists (measured). So Gate 3 registers job `release/auto-decide` on the existing DurableSchedule beside HEALTH_PROBE_JOB_ID (composition :801), 60s interval, single-flight built in. What IS mirrored from Gate 2: server-side, operator principal, a new module calling evaluatePolicy from @moe/core, provenance on the daemon-local persisted record, wire payload untouched.

2. PRINCIPAL: config.principalId (the operator id boot reconciliation already acts under, composition :635). NOT a `daemon:*` id — the fence at release-decide-command.ts:69-73 would refuse it OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_REQUIRED and every goal would park silently. No roster edit; MCP exclusion is derived and stays.

3. `base` BRANCH: there is NO server fact for it (grep defaultBranch|baseBranch|targetBranch non-test = 0 hits; ProjectRemote = {boundAt, boundBy, remoteUrl}). Decision: host-scoped daemon config `MOE_RELEASE_BASE`, passed raw (the DEPLOY_BUILD_CONTEXT_ENV_KEY shape). ABSENT = the reconciler yields for every candidate: fail closed, a human decides with their own base. A hard-coded "main" was rejected as contradicting async-entries.ts:270-274. This must be in the runbook.

4. ONE AUTOMATIC ATTEMPT PER (goal, sha). commandId = sha256(["release-auto", projectId, goalId, sha]). A REFUSED automatic terminal parks that sha for a human, because a retried deterministic id hits RELEASE_COMMAND_BYTES_CONFLICT once the aggregate version moved. A retry-after-REFUSED policy is a follow-up, not this row. The bound is stated in the module header.

5. PROVENANCE ON THE RELEASE RECEIPT, /2, WITH THE ID DOMAIN PINNED. `releaseReceiptId` hashes RELEASE_RECEIPT_VERSION (release-receipt-contracts.ts:106-108). A naive bump rotates every receipt id and makes stored /1 receipts unresolvable at deploy-command.ts:297 and goal-deployment-read.ts:46, and turns the whole release read UNREADABLE (release-evidence-read.ts:180-186). The plan pins a separate RECEIPT_ID_DOMAIN literal and requires an id-stability arm. Gate 2 does not have this hazard.

DEFERRED READS, BY DESIGN: the DossierGapCode name (from task-b8ec9a63's landed record — this row's dependsOn gates it) and the provenance key / layer literal (from Gate 2 if DONE, else `provenance` and the existing `"CORE_REDUCER"` literal with a comment posted on Gate 2). The plan names neither as a fact.

HUMAN REJECT WINS is PER GOAL: any recorded REJECTED terminal on `release:<goalId>` parks the automatic path until a human decides; a new sha does not un-park it. The service is NOT made sticky for a later human APPROVE. A REJECT is only recordable on a complete dossier (service.ts:144-178), so it is always an informed one.

Two prior handoffs on this row (2026-09-09) released it because the dossier producer had not landed. It still has not; the plan is submitted now because the only absent symbol is the gap code, which the DoD itself says to read from the sibling's landed record, and dependsOn holds WORKING claims until then.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: THE TRIGGER was the real design question and Gate 2's answer does not transfer. Gate 2 (task-b8571cfe, WORKING with an 8-step plan) fires the automatic preview decision from the preview.start async handler's completion and explicitly rejected the affordance read hot path. Gate 3 has NO in-daemon completion moment: criterion receipts (criterion-runner.ts:104-111) and PUSHED publish receipts (publish-ledger.ts:180) are written by the WRAPPER's delivery.advance() (agent-wrapper-main.ts:316,:350), the release dossier is recorded lazily INSIDE a release.decide dispatch (release-production-wiring.ts:62-71, sole caller release-decide-service.ts:153), and a grep for any store reactor/after-commit hook in the daemon returns nothing. So the trigger is a scheduled reconciler on the EXISTING DurableSchedule seam (registered beside HEALTH_PROBE_JOB_ID at daemon-store-foundation-composition.ts:801; single-flight per job built in). Rejected: an affordance-poll-time trigger (read hot path; Gate 2 rejected it for the same reason and the affordance layer must never dispatch); a new store reactor (does not exist, would be its own row); a new RUNTIME command kind (would rotate four GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST mirrors — the record is a STORE-ONLY kind, precedent internal.release.receipt). THE PRINCIPAL: the operator principal (config.principalId, the id boot reconciliation and document ingest already act under) so assertReleasePrincipal passes with NO roster edit; a `daemon:*` principal would be refused OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_REQUIRED and park every goal silently — an arm proves the fence still binds the daemon's own call. THE PROVENANCE HOME: the release receipt, version-bumped to /2 with a dual-vintage decoder, mirroring Gate 2's template; the strictly-minimal fallback (no bump, join the auto-approval record by commandId) was kept in reserve if the file cap bit — it did not. The `base` branch: no server fact exists for it (grep defaultBranch|baseBranch|targetBranch non-test = 0; ProjectRemote carries only remoteUrl), so it is host-scoped daemon config `MOE_RELEASE_BASE` passed raw, absent = fail closed; a hard-coded "main" contradicts the codebase's posture at async-entries.ts:270-274. ONE AUTOMATIC ATTEMPT PER (goal, sha): a REFUSED auto terminal parks the sha for a human, because a retried deterministic commandId hits RELEASE_COMMAND_BYTES_CONFLICT once the aggregate version moved; a retry policy is a follow-up, documented in the module header. The receipt-ledger vintage arms were folded into the new test file to keep the roster at nine with the two mandatory `.js` bridges.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: MEASURED 2026-09-10 by a 5-agent scout+design workflow at HEAD b3d295d8, verified zero source drift to 97268c4e; plan submitted at ecf0b862 with all owned paths clean. THE SEAM: release.decide is two layers composed at release-decide-service.ts:226. Outer wrapper release-decide-command.ts:163-220: assertReleasePrincipal FIRST (:93, via :69-73), envelope decode (:94), exact 4-key payload roster `["base","decision","goalId","sha"]` (:98-102), target check (:103), identity recomputed from the server-known principal (:169-175), replay (:176-181, RELEASE_COMMAND_ID_SPENT / RELEASE_COMMAND_BYTES_CONFLICT 409), pending intent under `daemon:release-command` (:182-188, RELEASE_COMMAND_IN_PROGRESS), expectedVersion (:189), hasPendingRelease walk (:190, :113-125), atomic two-leg ADMISSION commit (:191-201), execute, DomainRefusal -> REFUSED terminal (:208-212), DECISION commit with `${requestId}-decided` ReleaseCommandDecided (:213-218). Inner execute release-decide-service.ts:116-225: remote (:144-149), gaps (:151-163, RELEASE_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE naming criterion ids only), stored dossier (:165-172), REJECT short-circuit AFTER those checks (:174-178 — a REJECT is only recordable on a complete dossier, so a REJECT is always informed), already-released (:180-188, RELEASE_COMMAND_ID_REQUIRED 409), push (:190-201), PR (:203-212), record (:214-224). Closed code map release-decide-contracts.ts:38-45, exactly three keys. THE RECEIPT: ReleaseReceiptV1 release-receipt-contracts.ts:28-39, RECEIPT_KEYS :46-49, decoder :127-165, `releaseReceiptId` :106-108 HASHES the version literal — the rotation hazard. THE OPT-INS (task-a47301ee, DONE): one HOST-scoped policy slice, opt-in actions include the literal "release.decide", mapping STANDARD->R0 / ELEVATED->R1 / RESTRICTED->R3 in goal-risk-tier.ts; digest rotated once; foldSlices returns the LAST slice's optIns (policy-composition.ts:161-166) and the selector keeps the LAST digest-addressed installed slice (run-policy-selection-snapshot.ts:92-99). evaluatePolicy is exported from packages/core policy-public.ts:20 with POLICY_AUTO_APPROVAL_TIERS at :40; assessTier at policy-evaluation.ts:150-166 (HUMAN_ONLY_TIER :155-158, AUTO_APPROVAL_NOT_OPTED_IN :165, exact `entry.action === action` :157). RAIL 7 EDGE measured: apps/daemon/package.json `"@moe/core": "workspace:*"`, pnpm-lock importer apps/daemon -> link:../../packages/core, bare-specifier probe typechecks exit 0. The tier source the daemon already uses: readCriterionGoal -> planningRunRef -> readRunPolicyEvaluation(...).evaluation.riskTier (approval-record-facts.ts:215-231). THE SCHEDULE: durable-schedule.ts register :88, single-flight :66, DEFAULT_SCHEDULE_INTERVAL_MS 60_000 :3, throw flattening :57,:70, resolver :131-143 with the composition ternary at :788-789. PRECEDENTS for a daemon-internal principal: `daemon:release` (release-receipt-contracts.ts:24-26), `daemon:release-command` (release-decide-command.ts:18), `daemon:repository-recovery`. THE FENCE: release.decide in OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_KINDS (daemon-command-vocabulary.ts:405), MCP exclusion DERIVED (mcp-tool-allowlist.ts:94,:99 wiredMcpToolKinds), pins at gates-human-only-fence.test.ts:153-178 and mcp-tool-allowlist.test.ts:246-256 (:250 length 27). DIGEST MIRRORS, censused by HEX: f1878eea…2dd295 in six files. SIZES: release-decide-service.ts 227, release-receipt-contracts.ts 165, release-receipt-ledger.ts 155, release-decide-command.ts 221 (untouched), daemon-store-foundation-composition.ts 857 (pre-existing over-cap), release-receipt-ledger.test.ts 202 (8 arms, untouched). Every module in release/ carries a tracked `.js` bridge (13 of 15). Gate 2's planningNotes concede the preview receipt outcome is REFUSED|STARTED, not DEPLOYED.
planningNotes.risks: THE GAP CODE IS DEFERRED BY DESIGN — step 1 reads it from task-b8ec9a63's landed record; a worker who types CRITERION_NOT_VERIFIED_AT_SHA from this plan's prose has invented a symbol. THE RECEIPT-ID ROTATION is the silent one: bumping RELEASE_RECEIPT_VERSION without pinning the id domain makes every stored /1 RELEASED receipt unresolvable at deploy-command.ts:297 and goal-deployment-read.ts:46 and turns the whole release read UNREADABLE via release-evidence-read.ts:180-186; the id-stability arm is what catches it. JOURNAL CHURN (A10): dispatching a doomed decide every tick writes two decision records and two events on `release:<goalId>` per minute per stuck goal AND bumps the version the human's Decide card was minted against, so the human's card 409s every minute — the pre-checks (3)(4)(5) before any write are mandatory and the three-tick unchanged-version arm proves them. THE FENCE BINDS THE DAEMON TOO (A7): a `daemon:*` principalId is refused 403 and every goal parks SILENTLY forever; only the composed operator id passes; the arm dispatching under a daemon principal must be RED-by-refusal. LAST-SLICE-WINS (A4): installing the demo seed (opt-ins []) after the browser's slice silently disables auto-release; the fixture must install the opt-in slice LAST and an arm must prove the inverse order disables it. NEVER DECLARE A `*_LAYER` CONSTANT in the new modules — the security scanners demand a roster backfill; use the existing literal. THE SCHEDULE FLATTENS THROWS to SCHEDULE_CALLBACK_FAILED and discards the reason: every DomainRefusal from dispatch must be caught into a per-goal outcome. VACUOUS POSITIVE: an arm asserting only RELEASED passes against a human decision; assert provenance VALUES and that no other release.decide decision exists in the journal. GATE 2 MAY LAND WITH A DIFFERENT PROVENANCE KEY OR LAYER LITERAL — step 1 aligns to Gate 2 if DONE, otherwise defines and comments on Gate 2. daemon-store-foundation-composition.ts is 857 lines, already over the hard cap; this row adds at most five and must not be the row that grows it further. `MOE_RELEASE_BASE` absent = nothing auto-releases; that is fail-closed and must be stated in the runbook, not discovered.
